data.project_recycling: Project recycling into years without a verified calendar

data_description.project_recycling: Continues the every-other-week Blue/Yellow cadence past the last verified calendar year. Projected pickups are flagged as unverified.

new_recycling_calendar.title: Garland published its {year} recycling calendar
new_recycling_calendar.description: The City of Garland has posted a new annual Blue/Yellow recycling calendar for {year}. Recycling dates for {year} are currently projected from the previous year's every-other-week cadence. Compare the first few weeks with the calendar ({url}) and update the integration when a release verifies {year}.
